aka.zh: 北京—珠海公路（1981 年线路）

tagline.en: Beijing to the Macau border by Dezhou, Shangqiu, Jiujiang, Nanchang and Ganzhou, over a Yangtze bridge that took twenty years to finish
tagline.zh: 经德州、商丘、九江、南昌、赣州从北京到澳门边境，所过的长江大桥修了二十年

start.en: Gongbei port square, Xiangzhou, Zhuhai, at kilometre 2,693.622, connecting to Macau
start.zh: 珠海市香洲区拱北口岸广场，2693.622 公里处，连接澳门

end.en: Yongdingmen Bridge, Dongcheng, Beijing, where the chainage begins
end.zh: 北京市东城区永定门桥（里程计数起点）

en: G105 runs 2,693.622 km from Beijing to the Gongbei crossing into Macau, through Beijing, Hebei, Shandong, Henan, Anhui, Hubei, Jiangxi and Guangdong. It goes south through Yongqing, Wen'an and Dacheng in Langfang, Botou and Wuqiao, Dezhou, Gaotang and Dong'e, over the Yellow River to Pingyin, then Jining and Shan county, Shangqiu, Bozhou and Fuyang. It crosses the hill counties of western Anhui — Lu'an, Huoshan, Yuexi, Qianshan, Taihu, Susong — touches Hubei at Huangmei, crosses the Yangtze into Jiangxi at Jiujiang, and runs the length of Jiangxi by Nanchang, Fengcheng, Zhangshu, Ji'an, Taihe, Suichuan, Ganzhou and Longnan. In Guangdong it comes down by Lianping, Xinfeng and Conghua to Guangzhou, Foshan, Zhongshan and Zhuhai.

The 1981 route ended at Zhuhai and is listed at 2,717 km; the 2013 national highway plan formally carried it into Macau. In Guangzhou it shares Baiyun Avenue with G107 and Guangzhou Avenue with G324, and crosses the Pearl River on the Guangzhou Bridge and the Luoxi Bridge. North of Xinfeng the Chinese Wikipedia route description calls it a dangerous road along the mountainside.
zh: G105 自北京至通往澳门的拱北口岸，全长 2693.622 公里，途经北京、河北、山东、河南、安徽、湖北、江西、广东。它向南经廊坊永清、文安、大城，沧州泊头、吴桥，过德州、高唐、东阿，跨黄河至平阴，再经济宁、单县、商丘、亳州、阜阳。随后穿过皖西的六安、霍山、岳西、潜山、太湖、宿松等山区县，在黄梅入湖北，于九江跨长江进入江西，经南昌、丰城、樟树、吉安、泰和、遂川、赣州、龙南纵贯江西全境。进入广东后经连平、新丰、从化南下，抵广州、佛山、中山、珠海。
1981 年线路止于珠海，里程记为 2717 公里；《国家公路网规划（2013 年—2030 年）》正式将其延伸至澳门。在广州，它与 G107 共线走白云大道，与 G324 共线走广州大道，经广州大桥、洛溪大桥跨越珠江。中文维基百科的路线描述称新丰以北一段为“傍山险路”。

en: The Yellow River crossing between Dong'e and Pingyin is the Pingyin Yellow River Bridge, begun on 1 May 1969 and opened on 1 December 1970: 963.5 m long and 10 m wide, with a 611 m bolted and welded steel-truss main bridge of six spans. The name was settled, after several had been proposed, when the matter was put to the premier.

The Jiujiang Yangtze River Bridge is a double-deck road and rail bridge, the road on top: 4,460 m of four-lane road bridge over 7,675 m of double-track railway, now carrying the Beijing–Kowloon and Hefei–Jiujiang lines. Its three main spans of 216 m are steel trusses stiffened by flexible arches, a form first used in China here. It used 400,000 cubic metres of concrete and 80,000 tonnes of steel and cost 788 million yuan.

In the Pearl River delta the road used to cross the river branches by ferry. A Zhongshan resident's account published by People's Daily Online recalls that the trip to Guangzhou meant ferries at Shakou, Xijiao, Rongqi and Sanhongqi and took four or five hours, until the Shakou, Xijiao, Rongqi and Sanhongqi bridges opened in 1984.
zh: 东阿与平阴之间的黄河上是平阴黄河大桥，1969 年 5 月 1 日开工，1970 年 12 月 1 日通车：全长 963.5 米，宽 10 米，主桥 6 孔共 611 米，为栓焊钢桁架结构。拟定过几个桥名之后，经向周恩来总理汇报，才定名“平阴黄河大桥”。
九江长江大桥是公铁两用双层桥，上层公路、下层铁路：公路桥全长 4460 米，四车道；铁路桥全长 7675 米，双线，今承载京九、合九铁路。三个 216 米主跨采用在中国首次使用的三跨连续柔性拱刚性桁架结构。全桥用混凝土 40 万立方米、钢材 8 万吨，造价 7.88 亿元。
在珠江三角洲，这条路过去靠渡船过河。人民网刊登的一位中山市民的回忆说，中山去广州要过沙口、细滘、容奇、三洪奇等渡口，顺利也要四五个小时；1984 年沙口、细滘、容奇、三洪奇大桥开通后，才不再需要车船渡。

en: The Jiujiang bridge took twenty years. It was started in 1971 as the '702' war-preparedness project, a crossing that would keep north–south traffic moving if the Wuhan and Nanjing bridges were bombed; work began on 26 December 1973 with completion planned for 1977. Money ran short; by the end of 1979 only ten piers stood in the river. In 1980, in the economic readjustment, the state ordered the work halted, and in 1984 it was stopped again with only a maintenance crew kept on.

In December 1984 the general secretary of the Communist Party, visiting Jiujiang, suggested that the road deck could be built first and the cost shared by Hubei, Anhui, Jiangxi and the state. On 4 April 1987 the State Council approved resuming work. The steel trusses were joined on 18 May 1992, and the road bridge opened in January 1993; the railway followed on 1 October 1994, in time for the Beijing–Kowloon line.

G105 was numbered in the national trunk highway plan of November 1981, which named twelve radial routes out of Beijing. Since 2006 the bronze zero-kilometre marker in front of Zhengyangmen on Tiananmen Square has stood as the symbolic origin of these radials, though G105's own chainage starts at Yongdingmen Bridge to the south. The 2013 plan extended the route to Macau.
zh: 九江长江大桥修了二十年。1971 年，出于战备考虑，交通部决定启动该桥，列为“702”战备工程，以备武汉、南京长江大桥遭破坏时维持南北交通；1973 年 12 月 26 日正式动工，原计划 1977 年建成。此后资金不足，至 1979 年底仅完成水中 10 个桥墩。1980 年国民经济调整，国家要求停建；1984 年再次停建，仅留少量人员养护。
1984 年 12 月，中共中央总书记胡耀邦视察九江时指示，若技术可行可先建公路桥，并建议由湖北、安徽、江西三省和国家计委共同分担投资。1987 年 4 月 4 日，国务院批准恢复建设。1992 年 5 月 18 日钢桁梁合龙，1993 年 1 月公路桥通车；铁路桥于 1994 年 10 月 1 日通车，为京九铁路通车创造了条件。
1981 年 11 月的《国家干线公路网（试行方案）》为它定了编号，方案共有 12 条首都放射线。2006 年起，天安门广场正阳门前的青铜“中国公路零公里”标志成为这些放射线象征性的起点，不过 G105 本身的里程仍从南面的永定门桥起算。2013 年规划将其延伸至澳门。

en: When work on the Jiujiang bridge resumed in 1987 it was paid for by a state subsidy and local fundraising: the State Planning Commission, the railway and communications ministries and the three provinces together put up 150 million yuan for the main steel spans and the road deck, later raised to 216 million. By 2015 the road deck was in serious disrepair, and Jiangxi, Hubei and Anhui paid 1.1 billion yuan to strengthen it; it was closed to vehicles from 23 June 2015 and reopened on 8 January 2019.

The Pingyin bridge was still tolled in 2011, 41 years after it opened, at 10 yuan for a car, when a resident complained to the provincial party newspaper that this exceeded the legal maximum toll period.
zh: 1987 年九江长江大桥复工时，采用国家补助与地方集资的方式：国家计委、铁道部、交通部及江西、湖北、安徽三省共同筹资 1.5 亿元，用于正桥钢梁和公路桥面建设，后调整为 2.16 亿元。到 2015 年，公路桥病害严重，赣鄂皖三省出资 11 亿元加固改造；2015 年 6 月 23 日起禁止机动车通行，2019 年 1 月 8 日恢复通行。
平阴黄河大桥到 2011 年仍在收费，此时距通车已 41 年，小轿车每次 10 元；当年有市民向省委机关报反映，这已超过国家规定的最长收费期限。

why.en: No cost exists for the whole road, which links older provincial roads and is rebuilt section by section, each priced on its own. Sourced costs for its main bridges are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价：它连接各省原有道路，分段改建、分段计价。下列为主要桥梁有来源的造价。

why.en: No route-wide funding statement has been found. The Jiujiang bridge, the one large work whose funding is published, was paid for by the central ministries together with Jiangxi, Hubei and Anhui (see below).
why.zh: 未查到全线出资说明。唯一公布了出资构成的大型工程是九江长江大桥，由中央各部委与江西、湖北、安徽三省共同出资（见下）。

value.en: 2,693.622 km to the Gongbei end marker; 2,717 km on the 1981 Beijing–Zhuhai route
value.zh: 至拱北终点标志 2693.622 公里；1981 年北京至珠海线路 2717 公里

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 105国道 (citing a photograph of the end marker) and 中华人民共和国国道

label.zh: 九江长江大桥（公路桥 1993 年通车）

timeline.en: Work on the Pingyin Yellow River Bridge begins on 1 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 1 日，平阴黄河大桥开工。

timeline.en: The Pingyin Yellow River Bridge opens on 1 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 1 日，平阴黄河大桥通车。

timeline.en: Work on the Jiujiang Yangtze River Bridge begins on 26 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 26 日，九江长江大桥动工。

timeline.en: The national trunk highway plan of November names Beijing–Zhuhai as G105.
timeline.zh: 11 月，《国家干线公路网（试行方案）》将北京至珠海公路编为 105 国道。

timeline.en: Bridges at Shakou, Xijiao, Rongqi and Sanhongqi replace the delta ferries; work on the Jiujiang bridge is halted again.
timeline.zh: 沙口、细滘、容奇、三洪奇大桥开通，取代珠三角渡口；九江长江大桥再次停建。

timeline.en: The State Council approves resuming the Jiujiang bridge on 4 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 4 日，国务院批准恢复九江长江大桥建设。

timeline.en: The road deck of the Jiujiang Yangtze River Bridge opens in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，九江长江大桥公路桥通车。

timeline.en: The zero-kilometre marker for the radial highways is set in front of Zhengyangmen on 24 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 24 日，中国公路“零公里”标志安放于正阳门前。

timeline.en: The national highway plan extends G105 to Macau.
timeline.zh: 国家公路网规划将 G105 延伸至澳门。

timeline.en: The Jiujiang bridge road deck closes for strengthening on 23 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 23 日，九江长江大桥公路桥封闭加固改造。

timeline.en: The Jiujiang bridge reopens to road traffic on 8 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 8 日，九江长江大桥恢复通行。
